decisions.reason: A particle therapy water phantom extends the firm's decades of scanning-phantom and dosimetry know-how, and its in-house R&D lets it learn from early results, even though the 2019 site only mentions it rather than giving it its own page.
Small volume ionization chambers are core dosimetry products close to existing knowledge and showed stable presence across years.
This small-field chamber builds directly on the firm's established detector expertise and was consistently presented on its own page.
A standard clinical ionization chamber is central to the firm's accredited calibration and dosimetry base and is unlikely to be dropped.
A relative dosimetry chamber complements the firm's water phantom systems and lies within its deep related knowledge.
A thimble chamber is a classic dosimetry product well within the firm's competence and was stably presented.
